notes: Documents arrive the way you ask: one combined Word file, a file name you choose, or separate files. Questions come with options and a recommendation, and Decide for me goes with it. Instructions sent after a document is drafted amend it instead of starting over, and the redline shows what changed. If your AI provider sign-in stops working, drafting stops and tells you what to fix in Settings. Also: accept suggested edits one by one, cover memos written to your client, and much faster uploads on large matters.
